narratives.Description: First live doctor report says current vBRIEF document model after Module 1 forbids old names
narratives.Overview:
## Situation

Module 1 teaches that this course uses the current public term **xBRIEF** and schema `0.8`, and lists as a misconception: “Old names or schemas are fine for new material.”

Lab 2 is the first live Directive command. `directive doctor --full --project-root .` on a fresh 0.119.5 init exited 0 and opened with:

```text
Pre-cutover: none -- project is on the current vBRIEF document model.
xBrief migration: none -- xbrief active, vbrief removed.
```

Module 2 tells the learner to record doctor findings by classification. It does not say that the first line of a healthy 0.119.5 doctor report will still say “vBRIEF document model.” Module 7 later notes that 0.119.5 help and Task descriptions retain some `vBRIEF` wording; that warning arrives five modules after the first live sighting.

## Pain

After Module 1’s naming rule, I treated “current vBRIEF document model” as possible evidence that I had initialized the wrong product or an old schema. I spent time re-checking the pin (`@deftai/directive-core@0.119.5`) and `xbrief/` layout before accepting the doctor result.

A mid-level engineer is being trained to trust exact command output. The first health report uses the name the course just told them not to use for new material.

## Proposed fix

In Module 2 / Lab 2, record this as an expected 0.119.5 doctor fragment: healthy current projects can still print “vBRIEF document model” while the learner-facing files are xBRIEF 0.8. Tell the learner to classify it as retained upstream wording, not as a failed init or a license to write new `vbrief/` artifacts.

Optionally move the Module 7 vBRIEF-wording note earlier, next to the Lab 2 doctor warning already documented for `canonical-vendored-npm-signpost`.

OS: macOS Darwin 25.6.0 arm64  
Shell: zsh 5.9  
Directive: `@deftai/directive@0.119.5`  
Command: `directive doctor --full --project-root .` (exit 0)

Round 1 fresh critic, open critique, spend N=1. In-envelope: issue body plus Stop 1 comment 5768897028. File reads used `git show 19f2b3dd829d089519a22cfeaba8d0bbd7fb9e23:`. Probes ran only under `/tmp`.

The destination class holds: Lab 2 should quote the live 0.119.5 doctor opening fragment so a learner who just accepted Module 1's old-name rule can keep a healthy init. The proposed wording still needs a recut of output kind, which consecutive strings to quote, which files lock them, and what stays on Module 7.

## Re-verification

Stop 1 P1 anchors reproduced at the dispatch SHA.

- Module 1 line 258 forbids old names for new material and names xBRIEF 0.8. The Module 1 terminology table defines xBRIEF and never mentions vBRIEF.
- `git grep vBRIEF` over `curriculum/modules` and `labs` at this SHA hits only Module 6 strategy notes and the Module 7 help/Task note. Module 2 and Lab 2 contain zero `vBRIEF` tokens. Lab 2 Task 2 and Module 2 §4 quote only `canonical-vendored-npm-signpost`.
- Host `@deftai/directive@0.119.5` / `@deftai/directive-core@0.119.5`. `renderPrecutoverLine` on dest returns `Pre-cutover: none -- project is on the current vBRIEF document model.` `renderXbriefMigrationLine` returns `xBrief migration: none -- xbrief active, vbrief removed.` `directive doctor --full --project-root /tmp/dc51-doctor-probe` printed those two lines first, then the rest of the wrapper banner, then `cmdDoctor`.

The consumer CLI wrapper `dist/doctor.js` writes those lines on a valid human invocation before `cmdDoctor`. They carry no check id and no warning marker. `scripts/assert-doctor-warning-set.mjs` binds warning-row identity (`canonical-vendored-npm-signpost`) and already ignores this banner.

## Existing mechanisms

Reuse the #19 Lab 2 doctor lock: Module 2 §4, Lab 2 Task 2, Lab 2 solution, `scripts/verify-modules-2-3.mjs` taught-string asserts, `references/SOURCE-NOTES.md` warning-only replay, platform `doctor-full.txt` capture, and `assert-doctor-warning-set.mjs`. Module 7 lines 129–131 and `references/GLOSSARY.md` Legacy note already cover leftover help-surface wording. This fragment is a live status predicate in the doctor wrapper.

## Findings

### 1. Opening status banner is a different output kind than the classified warning

class: sharpens-framing

Evidence: `dist/doctor.js` prints `renderPrecutoverLine`, `renderXbriefMigrationLine`, `renderStaleHeaderLine`, deposit hygiene, and deposit closure, then runs `cmdDoctor`. Lab 2 Task 2 asks for each doctor finding's severity and one recommended next action. Module 2 §4 records warning/error classification and a single recommended action. On the healthy `none` path the Pre-cutover line has neither.

Failure mode: following "classify it as retained upstream wording" puts the banner in the O2.4 finding table. Learners hunt for a recommended action the engine does not print. The warning-identity checker cannot catch that prose error.

Disposition: quote the opening status lines as expected healthy output, in a separate sentence from the classified warning `canonical-vendored-npm-signpost`. Leave `EXPECTED_WARNING_IDS` as the signpost only.

### 2. Quote the consecutive pair and the engine's three-era meaning

class: sharpens-framing

Evidence: `renderPrecutoverLine` returns the "current vBRIEF document model" sentence when `detectPreCutover` is false. `frozenPreCutoverMigrationGuidance` names the chain pre-v0.20 flat model → vBRIEF v0.6 → xBRIEF. Wrapper comment `#2022` calls this pre-v0.20 document-model state. The next printed line already reports `xbrief active, vbrief removed.` Module 1 never names the token `vBRIEF`, so this banner is the first live sighting of that word on the beginner path.

Failure mode: quoting only "vBRIEF document model" without the companion line or the three-era gloss leaves the Module 1 collision in place. Calling it retained upstream wording lumps it with Module 7 help cards, a different surface.

Disposition: Lab 2 Task 2, Module 2 §4, and the Lab 2 solution quote both live strings and state that this banner's "vBRIEF" means post-pre-cutover document-model state, while learner-facing files stay xBRIEF 0.8. New course writes stay `xbrief/` schema 0.8.

### 3. Module 7 help/Task note stays on Module 7

class: sharpens-framing

Evidence: Module 7 lines 129–131 already record that 0.119.5 help and Task descriptions retain `vBRIEF` wording as a documentation disagreement. That surface is `scope:promote` / `scope:activate` help and Task descriptions.

Failure mode: the issue's optional "move the Module 7 note earlier" sentence leaves this identity unbounded and mixes two mechanisms.

Disposition: this recut covers the Lab 2 doctor opening banner. The Module 7 help/Task sentence stays in Module 7.

### 4. Taught banner strings need the same content-contract lock #19 used for the warning

class: sharpens-framing

Evidence: `verify-modules-2-3.mjs` requires `canonical-vendored-npm-signpost` in the three learner files and rejects `Missing directory: xbrief/`. Platform lanes already write `doctor-full.txt` and run `assert-doctor-warning-set.mjs`. SOURCE-NOTES records warning lines only.

Failure mode: a prose-only recut can drift on the next pin, the same class of defect #19 already closed for the warning row.

Disposition: add a `verify-modules-2-3.mjs` assert that those three files quote `Pre-cutover: none -- project is on the current vBRIEF document model.` and `xBrief migration: none -- xbrief active, vbrief removed.` Keep the warning-set checker on warning rows. A substring check on the already-captured `doctor-full.txt` covers engine-string drift if the parent wants that extra lock.

### 5. Third wrapper banner also carries a vbrief token

class: footnote

`renderStaleHeaderLine` on dest returns `AGENTS.md header drift: none -- unmanaged header has no legacy vbrief path literals.` Same wrapper block, lowercase path token. No disposition weight.

## Road not taken

Widening `assert-doctor-warning-set.mjs` to parse banners. That checker exists to bind warning-row identity after #19; the banners are a different printer. A taught-string assert in `verify-modules-2-3.mjs` plus the existing capture is the mechanism already on this path. That choice would flip if a pin-matched Lab 2 `doctor-full.txt` stopped containing the Pre-cutover `none` line.
